title: Exserted
summary: EXSERT'ED, a. [L. exsero; ex and sero. See Exert.] Standing out; protruded from the corol; as stamens exsert. A small portion of the basal edge of the shell exserted.

inlines.v: EXSERT'ED, a. [L. exsero; ex and sero. See Exert.] Standing out; protruded from the corol; as stamens exsert. A small portion of the basal edge of the shell exserted.
